brief: I want to understand how EU and US rules on AI in hiring differ between 2023 and 2026, for an HR team deploying a CV screening tool in both regions.
tasks: EU: obligations for high-risk AI in employment under the AI Act (Annex III), with application dates. Primary sources: EUR-Lex, Commission guidance. Output: obligations list with article numbers.
US federal: EEOC guidance on AI and Title VII / ADA since 2023, and any withdrawals. Primary sources: eeoc.gov, Federal Register.
US state and city: NYC Local Law 144 bias audits, Colorado AI Act, Illinois HB 3773. Output: table of law, scope, effective date, audit duty.
Practice: what bias audits and notices cost and look like in practice. Prefer audit firm publications and regulator FAQs over vendor blogs.
boundaries: Task 2 covers federal only; task 3 covers state and city only. Nobody covers UK or Canada.
